description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing price target data from Finviz, including query parameters, data models, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: FinvizPriceTargetQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Finviz price target query parameters, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FinvizPriceTargetData
classes.description: Model representing the price target data with fields for status and rating change.

classes.name: FinvizPriceTargetFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that retrieves and processes price target data from Finviz.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts generic query parameters into Finviz-specific query parameters.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw price target data from Finviz for given symbols and handles errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Validates and transforms raw data into FinvizPriceTargetData models.
